name: Transmute Metal to Stone (Orphaned Bookworm Productions)
body:
School transmutation [earth, metal]; Level druid 7, sorcerer/wizard 7

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, M/DF (rust)

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)

Area up to two 10-ft. cubes/level (S)

Duration permanent; see text

Saving Throw see text; Spell Resistance see text

This spell enables you to change all metal within the area into stone. This includes weapons and armor. A magical metal object is treated as having spell resistance equal to 20 + its caster level. This spell cannot affect artifacts. An object changed to stone has its weight reduced to 75% if it is predominantly metal, the hardness is reduced by 2 and the hit points are halved.

Weapons have half their hardness and have the fragile quality, but are otherwise unaffected. There is no other effect to other objects or armor.

The stone remains until a successful dispel magic or transmute stone to metal spell restores its substance but not necessarily its form. Transmute metal to stone counters and dispels transmute stone to metal.
